verdict.rationale: Adyen clearly documents in-person payment acceptance on PCI PTS certified terminals via the Terminal API, and it explicitly supports contactless through Tap to Pay on iPhone and other smartphones. Its docs also state it accepts 'global and local payment methods'. However, chip (EMV insert) acceptance and Apple Pay / Google Pay wallets are never named, so these elements are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of chip/EMV card acceptance, explicit mention of Apple Pay/Google Pay wallet support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
